gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed WHO classification of recurrent glioblastoma grade IV;

candidate_evidence.quote: Efficacy and Safety of Niraparib Combined With Radiotherapy in Patients With Recurrent Glioblastoma

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: mainly patients with first recurrence of glioblastoma, and the requirement is that they can receive secondary radiotherapy

role_evidence.quote: patients were given niraparib 300mg/day (body weight ≥77Kg and baseline platelet count ≥150,000/µL) or 200mg/day (body weight \<77Kg or baseline platelet count \<150,000/µL), combined with radiotherapy (total dose 55Gy)

coder_notes: Re-irradiation plus niraparib in recurrent GBM. MGMT promoter methylation is explicitly not required ('Regardless of whether ... the MGMT promoter is methylated'), so no biomarker row. No WHO edition or IDH requirement stated: cns5_terminology unclear.
